what: Mallinson et al. 2024 Ti (I+II) NLTE departure-coefficient grid, PySME DirectAccessFile (.grd), for deriving OUR solar Ti I NLTE abundance correction. Replaces the outdated Bergemann-2011 scaled-Drawin atom that inflated the Engine-A (MAFAGS-OS +0.108) and Engine-B (MARCS +0.20) corrections (RYA-542 adjudication).
model_atom: Mallinson et al. 2024 (A&A 687, A77) Ti model atom: 587 levels (459 Ti I + 127 Ti II + Ti III ground). Inelastic H collisions: ab initio Grumer & Barklem (2020) for Ti I; Sitnova et al. (2020) for Ti II. Abundances relative to Grevesse et al. 2007.
reader_note: Our Amarsi-format PySMEGrid reader (pipeline/nlte_bfactor_synth.read_amarsi_grid) MIS-PARSES this grid's internal level table (same v1.10 container, different layout: returns 813 garbage levels). Level labels for line matching MUST be read from the ASCII label_Ti.txt (NIST energies); the DEPARTURES are read natively by PySME's set_nlte at synthesis time (works). See scripts/rya544_ti_mallinson.py::_label_index.

derivation.method: pipeline/pysme_nlte.py (PySME NLTE-vs-LTE COG) on the MARCS solar node 5772/4.44/0.0/1.0, A(Ti)=4.97. delta = A_used - A* where EW_LTE(A*) = EW_NLTE. Level labels energy-matched from label_Ti.txt.
derivation.cross_check: OUR +0.0506 reproduces Mallinson-2024's reported solar Ti I correction +0.052 (and Mallinson-2022 +0.03 / Sitnova-2020 +0.03, ab-initio ~+0.04). Departures engaged; validate-don't-tune (RYA-544 firewall).

status: ACQUIRED + DERIVED, but NOT WIRED to production. The RYA-544 ionization-balance acceptance gate STOPPED: OUR Ti I pool (n=9 weak lines) gives A_LTE 5.598 with MAD 0.508 dex vs OUR clean Ti II 5.008 (MAD 0.032) -> imbalance +0.643 >> FE_IONISATION_GATE 0.05. The NLTE correction (+0.0506) is a differential (gf cancels) and is sound; the imbalance is OUR Ti I gf-scale (the RYA-521/395/398 +0.502-residual thin graded pool), which swamps the correction. Fix the Ti I gf-scale + re-gate before wiring this grid (follow-on).
